description: This file defines the Cookies class within the Slim Framework's PSR-7 implementation, handling HTTP cookie management including setting, retrieving, and parsing cookies.

classes.name: Cookies
classes.description: A class for managing HTTP cookies, including setting default properties, adding cookies to responses, retrieving cookies from requests, and parsing cookie headers.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Cookies object with optional request cookies.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a cookie value by name from the request cookies.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a cookie for the response with specified properties.

methods.name: toHeaders
methods.description: Converts response cookies into header strings.

methods.name: toHeader
methods.description: Formats a single cookie into a Set-Cookie header string.

methods.name: parseHeader
methods.description: Parses cookie header string into an associative array of cookie names and values.
